title: Enterprise Connectivity: campaign channels
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following campaign channels for each named contract tier. Channels eligible for campaign pricing; string list.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | campaign channels | portal; api |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | campaign channels | portal; api |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | campaign channels | portal; api |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | campaign channels | portal; api |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | campaign channels | portal; api |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | campaign channels | portal; api |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the campaign channels is portal; api.
